items.briefing:
Quest Apartment Hotels has confirmed a customer data breach caused by a vulnerability in a third-party system, so if you've stayed with Quest recently, monitor your accounts for suspicious activity. Separately, the Australian Cyber Security Centre (ACSC) is warning that a software tool called N-able N-central is being actively exploited by attackers in Australia — organisations using this IT management software should apply patches immediately.

ASIC is also alerting Australians about scammers using AI-generated deepfakes to create fake investment networks that can look convincing. **Practical tip:** If you receive an unsolicited investment opportunity online — even if it features a recognisable face or brand — verify it independently through official sources before engaging.

featured.title: Semperis launches global tour for cyber war documentary
featured.summary: The documentary's global rollout will take its account of cyber attacks on vital services to more than 30 cities, including Sydney.
